d:
Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's US Senate race, becoming the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate. The Democrat defeated Republican Mike Rogers despite facing intense criticism from Donald Trump, who called him a jihadist and questioned his alleged links to the Muslim Brotherhood. Here's a look at El-Sayed's background, political positions and the controversy surrounding his campaign.
